notes:
Important fix: DryDock no longer writes over a save the game has written since you opened it. If you played with DryDock open, a build arriving from Blender (or Save to game) used to put the older save back; now nothing is written and DryDock offers to open the new save
When your corvette was changed in the game since Blender last sent its build (decals, new parts), DryDock asks before Blender's build replaces it: don't write, update the Blender file, or use Blender's build
Backups made in the same second no longer share a folder
